mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical Fed rate threshold of 4.0% in 2008
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.2pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over two months indicate severe consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2008 housing and retail sales collapse
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising >0.25pp over three months), reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% suppresses consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over one month signal rapid labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises by >0.1pp in one month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 4.5%), reduced consumer spending and profit pressures cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.
